title: A sixteen-prime-factor bound for Lehmer's totient problem and exact prime-completion criteria - research revision

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India; formerly, University of Calcutta (Heramba Chandra College), 23/49 Gariahat Road, Golpark, Kolkata 700029, West Bengal, India

description:
Programs, logs and LaTeX source of version 3 of hexagon:2610.00454, a sixteen-prime-factor bound for Lehmer's totient problem. The full conjecture remains unproved.

This version proves by finite search that a quotient (n-1)/phi(n) or (n+1)/phi(n) of at least 3 forces at least 20001 distinct prime factors, with the size bound n < 2^(2^(k-19981)), and that every solution of phi(n) | n+1 other than the nine known ones exceeds 10^26. Prime factors below 2^64 in the eight-prime search are certified by the strong probable-prime test to the bases 2 to 37 (Sorenson and Webster), so that no result depends on unrefereed work. The earlier results (at least 16 prime factors, n > 10^35, more than 10^9 prime factors when 3 | n) are retained. The programs (C with GMP, Python, PARI/GP) and their logs are included, and the paper states which counts were obtained by two programs.

Author: Deep Bhattacharjee (d.bhattacharjee@erl-forschung.de, itsdeep@live.com; GitHub-related contact egspl@proton.me). No journal submission, acceptance or full closure is asserted.
